messages:
Priya (Design): Heads-up: new compact pool-row mock for autoscale. Main asks: make SLO slider modes explicit (Off / Preset / Custom), surface Burst billing earlier, and ensure pool picker -> burst -> slo tab order is linear. Loom with screens in thread. Noah (Frontend): I can do a compact floating burst toggle anchored to the row right. Note: moving it out will increase row height a bit. DOM order will determine tabbing; we can reorder but need design buy-in. Ava (A11Y): Accessibility checks: burst pill contrast currently ~3.7:1, must be >=4.5:1. Slider needs aria-valuetext including mode (eg "SLO 250ms, preset"). Preset chips should use aria-pressed. Add visible focus outline and ensure burst reachable with one Tab from pool picker. Sam (PM): Defaults must be conservative. Snap SLO to presets by default and require an explicit "Edit" to go custom. Add guardrail: when burst >=50% show inline hint "Estimated cost impact" and a small link to compare costs. No auto-upgrade — soft nudge only. Jae (Eng): Backend notes: map presets to preset_id, store custom values numerically. burst maps to burst_quota scoped to pool_id. Enforce burst_quota <= pool.max_gpus server-side and return a warning flag for client to show a nudge. Maya (Research): Quick usability ask: run a 5-min moderated test on the compact row to ensure users spot burst affordance. I'll take it after staging is up. Priya (Design): Microcopy proposals: label -> "Burst capacity"; tooltip -> "Temporary extra GPUs for traffic spikes. Billed while active." Slider state visuals: Off = ghost label "Disabled"; Preset = filled track + preset chip; Custom = filled track + numeric readout. Noah (Frontend): For ARIA I'll add role="slider" + aria-valuemin/max/now and aria-valuetext. Also include an aria-live region for cost-estimate updates:
Estimated monthly cost: $X
. Will implement DOM order pool picker -> burst -> slo. Ava (A11Y): Perfect. Also ensure state isn't conveyed by color alone (icons/text). Sam (PM): Copy for nudge: "This SLO may need more capacity — view options" (less alarming). Confirmed. Jae (Eng): We'll feature-flag behind autoscale-v3, debounce cost API calls at 400ms, and cap burst on submit. Noah (Frontend): I'll ship prototype to staging behind the flag and request design/a11y review. deploy-bot: deploy/ui-staging v2.30.0 succeeded — https://staging.redwood.dev/deploys/4499 Priya (Design): Thanks everyone — I'll push updated FigJam frames and schedule a 10-min pass once staging flag is on. :rocket:
